# Valkyrie scenario catalogue

`js/valkyrie.js` is generated from the scenario catalogue of the Valkyrie app,
[github.com/NPBruce/valkyrie-store](https://github.com/NPBruce/valkyrie-store) (`MoM/manifestDownload.ini`),
which is published under the Apache License 2.0 (a copy is in `LICENSE` here).

What this site takes from it: scenario names (with version tags removed), authors, difficulty, length, languages,
the community play statistics, and each scenario's description as written by its author (English where provided,
otherwise the original language). Descriptions have markup removed and very long ones are shortened; nothing else is
changed. Descriptions remain the work of their authors and are credited on the site.
